QuestInfo.name: [Alliance Mission] Expedition Mission - Light of Annihilation
QuestInfo.1:
Many Expedition members are falling victim to the giant's Light of Annihilation attacks. Learn to defend against the attacks by using Erda wisely. After completing your objective, report to #b#p3003564##k to complete the mission.

The giant #rsometimes#k uses Light of Annihilation, which #rdoes more damage than you have health.#k Your current Erda can be seen above your HP bar. If you have collected enough #bErda#k by defeating monsters, some of the damage will be absorbed by the Erda and #byou will receive the remaining damage.#k To be safe, keep your HP as high as possible and maintain at least 70% Erda in reserve. If you are being protected by the Alliance protection effect which you receive immediately after entering the field, you will be unable to use Erda to defend against attacks, and won't be able to complete the Expedition mission.

#rThis mission is extremely difficult and dangerous. Be especially wary of the giant's Light of Annihilation and Light of Judgment attacks.#k
QuestInfo.2: You learned how to block the Light of Annihilation with Erda and finished the Expedition mission.
